Best bar & best team in Hanoi!!!
Mar 2026 • Friends
I have been a loyal patron of Hiệp since his days working at the JW Marriott Hotel, and following him to House of Barbaard has proven to be an absolutely brilliant decision. Due to a busy schedule, it had been quite a long time since my last visit, but stepping back into this place felt exactly like coming home only better.
First and foremost, I must give a massive shoutout to the incredible concept of House of Barbaard. It is far more than just a place for gentlemen's grooming or grabbing a quick drink; it is a true sanctuary. The classic, sophisticated, yet incredibly cozy vintage vibe, combined with the captivating music, creates an atmosphere that completely isolates you from the hustle and bustle of the outside world. It is a meticulously crafted concept with impeccable taste that consistently maintains its high-class standards.
However, the true soul of my evening, and the main reason I am writing this lengthy review, is the unparalleled service provided by Hiệp. As I mentioned, it had been a very long time since my last visit. Yet, the very moment I took my seat at the bar, Hiệp not only warmly welcomed me back but remembered every single detail of my preferences, habits, and specific tastes in drinks from our JW Marriott days. Having a bartender remember such tiny, personal details after so long is genuinely astonishing and deeply touching. It proves that Hiệp works not just with outstanding professional skills, but with his heart, immense respect, and a keen, observant eye for his guests.
Speaking of his bartending skills, "masterful" is the only word that does him justice. The cocktails he crafts are not only visually stunning and perfectly balanced in flavor, but they also always feel entirely tailored to my exact mood. Every movement behind the bar is smooth, and the way he shares the stories behind his creations is incredibly engaging.
Beyond the drinks, his customer care is absolute perfection. He is enthusiastically dedicated, yet wonderfully tactful and perfectly measured. He is never overbearing; he instinctively knows when a guest needs personal space to unwind and when they are in the mood for a great conversation. He makes you feel incredibly comfortable, relaxed, and respected at every moment.
My experience at House of Barbaard today is a resounding 10/10. A huge thank you to the establishment for creating such a top-tier space, and a special, profound thank you to Hiệp for the thoughtfulness and warmth that made my evening flawless. I certainly won’t let the gap between my visits be as long as the last one. If you ever visit House of Barbaard, do yourself a favor: grab a seat at the bar and ask Hiệp to mix you a drink. You will absolutely not be disappointed!

reviews.review_text:
International food guy
Seattle, Washington24 contributions
0
Speakeasy Hanoi!
Sep 2025 • Couples
This bar is located behind a Chic barbershop in the Melia Hanoi Hotel in the French quarter.
Go to the 3rd floor pool, take a turn by the spa and Voila there you are with some gatekeepers by two large closed doors with no signage. 

It is owned by a Dutch owner not affiliated with the hotel and has three different vibe rooms and an outdoor balcony seating over the front hotel lobby entry. 

We sat in the front bar area with a DJ in a balcony perch above it all spinning classic and euro disco mixes with a great vibe even us old folks can really enjoy. Not our usual thing but really fun and glad we sat here! 

There is also a very upscale classy “library” room that is popular for older types and folks that want to have easier conversation. Also a cigar lounge we didn’t look into for the obvious reasons as non smokers. 

Our waiter was funny and interesting! I usually order the same boring dark rum and coke and they had that but wow what great classic cocktail and specialty cocktail choices!! 

So I ordered the Sherlock Holmes rum drink and he came to tell me that I must have “forgotten this” hanging me a detectives hat and a big prop pipe with my signature cocktail . It was very good and a good choice.

I can’t remember my wife’s drink but it came in a trick box and he advised me to film it. She opened it up to butterflies flying out! Then told her to try eating this worm from a cocoon that was just dense marshmallow. Funny girl!!!
Still cracking up!!!!

We then got pretty basic mixed drinks that were very good too. Their liquor selection excellent but for a vodka snob it was lacking a good potato vodka. The server was very entertaining and knowledgeable but I was able to actually have fun instructing him on better choices than Belvedere and Tito’s. 

This in my opinion is a must do if you go to Hanoi and want a great bar experience.
It’s a little more expensive by Viet standards but very comparable to US and European prices.

Cool and relaxing barbershop experience
Jun 2025 • Solo
I got the Signature Haircut and Hot Towel Beard Shave. My stylist was Khuyen and he did an amazing job. He was professional, friendly, knowledgeable, and made easy conversation. He spoke excellent English and communicated clearly throughout the appointment. The location is right out of a movie set, it’s elegant, inviting, cozy, and leaves a lasting impression. You can tell the staff enjoys working there and that makes a huge difference in the experience. Khuyen did not rush the job, he paid careful attention to detail and made sure he managed around my 2 cowlicks as he cut my hair. The hot towel service was relaxing and enjoyable. All the products they use have light and pleasant scents that don’t overpower the senses. The price was amazing considering the quality of service and extras you get like a beverage and snack. Overall i say this place is most definitely worth a visit (and revista as well). Book an appointment ahead to make sure you get the time you need and I recommend Khuyen for exceptional service.

Hotel Special cocktail bar for an unforgettable evening
Dec 2024 • Couples
We spent a great evening at the special cocktail bar on the 3rd floor of the hotel. The interior created a really beautiful, cozy yet luxurious atmosphere. We ordered TNT, a signature cocktail, which not only tasted really great, but was also very impressive with the great show that took place during the preparation.

We listened to good music with our partners and spent a relaxing time in a wonderful atmosphere. There was a separate balcony for smoking, which was convenient, and there was a stylish barber room so you could have a light haircut.

The staff was very friendly and the service was also great. Overall it was a really great experience and I would definitely like to visit again!
